reason: The description gives no voltage or current, so it fits all four BMS PCBAs, and price is the only separator. BMS-19537 ($2.36, Suntronix) also fits, at about 28% above. BMS-19562 ($3.09) matches the price closely but comes from a different supplier, Redfield.
